source: (()=>{const deny=()=>{throw new DOMException('Clipboard belongs to the user','NotAllowedError')};try{Object.defineProperty(navigator,'clipboard',{value:Object.freeze({read:deny,write:deny,readText:deny,writeText:deny}),configurable:false,writable:false})}catch{}const original=Document.prototype.execCommand;try{Object.defineProperty(Document.prototype,'execCommand',{value:function(command,...args){if(/^(copy|cut|paste)$/i.test(command))return deny();return original.call(this,command,...args)},configurable:false,writable:false})}catch{}for(const kind of ['copy','cut','paste'])addEventListener(kind,event=>{event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation()},true)})()
